assessment: This manuscript demonstrates that iPSCs retain the molecular transcriptional signature associated with a healthy or osteoarthritic (OA) state, depending upon the origin of donor cells. Using iPSCs derived from healthy (AC-iPSCs) or OA cartilage, the data show that epigenetic and metabolism-specific transcriptional signals affect the subsequent differentiation of iPSCs to chondrocytes. These findings significantly contribute to the field of regenerative medicine and pave the way to further design new approaches to control and regulate the differentiation of iPSCs to desired cell types.
